steps.text: Make sure the modem is not plugged into your computer.
Plug the modem into an unfiltered AC outlet.
Plug the square end of the included USB cable into the modem's USB jack and the rectangular end into an available port on your computer.

notes: HouseLinc adds the modem as its computer interface: in HouseLinc's Options window click Start, select the modem and click Activate.

steps.text: Press and hold the SET button for more than three seconds.
steps.expect: LED blinks continuously, half a second on and half a second off

notes: Then press and hold the SET button on the device you want to link to the modem; the modem reports ALL-Linking Completed with the other device's ID.
When linking is started with the SET button, the modem decides the controller or responder role and assigns the ALL-Link group automatically.
Software can end linking mode with Cancel ALL-Linking, and can turn off SET button linking by setting bit 7 of the modem's configuration flags.
The Insteon Modem Developer's Guide gives 4 minutes for linking mode started with Start ALL-Linking.

steps.text: Have software send the Start ALL-Linking command, choosing whether the modem links as controller, as responder, or as controller when it starts the session and responder otherwise, and the ALL-Link group.
steps.expect: LED blinks continuously, half a second on and half a second off

steps.text: Have software send the Start ALL-Linking command with link code 0xFF and the ALL-Link group to unlink.
steps.expect: The modem enters unlinking mode for 4 minutes

steps.text: Press and hold the SET button on the device to unlink.
steps.expect: ALL-Linking Completed reports link code 0xFF, meaning the link was deleted

notes: The Insteon Modem Developer's Guide gives no SET button sequence for the modem's own unlinking mode.

verification.note: Taken from the Insteon Modem Developer's Guide's command example; no owner's document describes unlinking the modem.

steps.text: Press and hold the SET button while applying power, and keep holding it for 10 seconds.
steps.expect: LED stays off during the reset, then turns on steadily (or blinks six times if the modem has no external EEPROM)

notes: After a SET button reset the modem sends User Reset Detected.

steps.text: Have software send the Reset the IM command.
